learning_outcomes.text: Explain realistic AI use cases across the instructional design function
Use AI tools effectively and ground their output
Use AI to draft outcomes, outlines, storyboards and scripts
Apply AI to support production and quality review
Govern AI use for risk, confidentiality and accuracy and accessibility
Lead responsible, ethical AI adoption in instructional design and course production

integrative_case: A course producer wants to use AI across course production responsibly. Map suitable use cases, use AI to draft design artefacts and production assets with grounding and SME review, classify content data and design an approval and audit trail, plan a safe pilot, and set a policy covering accuracy, accessibility and disclosure.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
